data.desc: Elevra Lithium Limited is a North American lithium producer (ASX:ELV; NASDAQ:ELVR) with projects in Quebec, Canada, United States, and a Joint Venture in Western Australia. Elevra's assets comprise North American Lithium (100%), a 60% stake in the Moblan Lithium Project in Central Quebec and the Carolina Lithium project (100%) in the United States.
data.industry: Mining & Quarrying of Nonmetallic Minerals (No Fuels)
